==About==

Crafting {{i|Saurkraut}} will make an {{i|Unfermented Cabbage}} which can then be placed in a [[Container]] for a few days to produce a Saurkraut. Saurkraut is a major [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Cabbage and Kale}} Food Group. Eating Saurkraut will '''NOT''' give you back a {{i|Glass Jar}}.
